The '''Imperial Testing Grounds''' was a scientific [[Starship/Legends|starship]] testing facility that was located on the [[Outer Moon]] of [[Prakith/Legends|Prakith]]. During the early years of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation]] and [[Sublight Products Corporation|Subpro Corporation]] co-operated to develop a scout ship there.
